posts.text: · 15t siden: NORBIT Subsea is pleased to announce the delivery of advanced multibeam sonar systems to Geoservices Maritime Pvt. Ltd. , based in Mumbai and one of India’s fastest-growing survey companies.  The systems will support Geoservices Maritime’s recently awarded five-year IV contract for survey and positioning services in the offshore fields of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC). brand-new X-series sonar system. The delivery includes four WBMS X kits in dual-head configuration.  “We are proud to be associated with this prestigious ONGC project and look forward to leveraging NORBIT’s advanced technology to deliver high-quality, reliable, and efficient survey solutions.”  — Sudhir Walia, Director, Geoservices Maritime
